svg.title: Orion Workbench — revision review design target
svg.desc: A terminal-inspired desktop workbench. The project tree selects Mount plate. In the centre viewport an enclosure assembly is exploded and the 44.0 millimetre hole spacing is marked. At right, r06 measures 42.0 mm and r07 measures 44.0 mm. A save review action is waiting. The command console is docked below.
